cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 36 since 2002. Owner of Wood's Auto Body Shop and a veteran of the Alabama National Guard. Served as a Calhoun County commissioner from 1998 to 2002.

endorsements.text: In 2010, his endorsements included the Alabama Tea Party Express (per Ballotpedia). In 2012 he endorsed Mitt Romney for president.

cands.gaps: His birthplace, where he was raised and when he came to Alabama were not found. No land-use or development stances were found. No controversies or foreign ties were found. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, so no self-described platform was available.
